title: An Image is Worth a Thousand Toxic Words: A Metamorphic Testing Framework for Content Moderation Software
reasoning: The paper is a technical evaluation of the robustness of content moderation software using metamorphic testing. Its primary focus is on detecting toxic content (hate speech, spam, pornography) embedded in images. While it mentions hate speech targeting religions, it does not benchmark or evaluate religious beliefs, theological frameworks, or moral and ethical reasoning systems.
